summary: DSM GET-shaped writes must bypass cache and ambiguous retries; MCP must disclose their effects, redact login credentials, and preserve attached downloads byte-for-byte or return explicit size errors.
reason: DSM uses GET for state-changing operations and embeds live credentials and binary transport envelopes in responses; generic GET retry/cache, read-only annotations and text handling are unsafe.
validated_outcome: Credential precedence tests verify stored credentials while preserving DSM session authentication without an Authorization header.
